blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Filipino-American actor Vincent Rodriguez III is set to make a guest appearance in the 23rd season of the long-running medical drama “Grey’s Anatomy,” where he will portray a patient in an upcoming episode. Rodriguez announced the news in a Facebook post, sharing a photo of himself wearing a hospital wristband during his visit to the show’s fictional Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital. The actor revealed that the episode will air on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 10 p.m. Eastern Time on ABC and will become available on Hulu the following morning.
